usageNotes: Returns a directory index of subscription entries registered in Proxmox Datacenter Manager. Use this as a discovery call to determine which subscription resources are available before fetching or managing individual subscription details. No authentication role restrictions apply — any authenticated user or API token may call it.

examples.summary: List all PDM subscription directory entries

tips: The returns type is 'null' in the spec, meaning the API may return an empty body or a bare list — inspect the raw response rather than expecting a typed schema.
This is a directory index, not a full subscription detail endpoint; a follow-up call may be needed to retrieve subscription key or status fields.
Accessible to all authenticated users, so no elevated privilege is required to probe subscription availability.
